items.title: Room Booking Management
items.description: Enables users to search and book rooms while preventing double bookings and allowing administrative oversight.

items.title: College Account Sign-In
items.description: As a student or staff member, I want to sign in with my existing college account, so that I can access the room booking system.

criteria.text: When a user attempts to sign in with valid college account credentials, the user is successfully authenticated.

citations.quote: - Students and staff sign in with their existing college account.

items.title: Search Rooms
items.description: As a user, I want to search rooms by date, time and capacity, so that I can find an appropriate space.

criteria.text: When a user provides a date, time, and capacity, the system displays rooms matching those criteria.

citations.quote: - A user can search rooms by date, time and capacity, and book an individual one-off slot.

items.title: Book an Individual One-Off Slot
items.description: As a user, I want to book an individual one-off slot, so that I can secure a study room.

criteria.text: When a user books an available time slot, the booking is confirmed.

citations.quote: - A user can search rooms by date, time and capacity, and book an individual one-off slot.

items.title: Prevent Overlapping Bookings
items.description: As a project sponsor, I want to ensure zero double bookings, so that room scheduling conflicts are eliminated.

criteria.text: When a user tries to book a room for a time that overlaps with an existing booking, the booking service rejects the overlapping booking.

citations.quote: The booking service will reject an overlapping booking for the same room.

items.title: View Room Availability and Booking Details
items.description: As a student or staff member, I want to see which study rooms are free, so that I can choose an available room.

criteria.text: When a student views a taken room, the system shows that the room is taken without revealing who took it.

citations.quote: Students should only see that a room is taken, not who took it.

items.title: Facilities Office Booking Overview and Maintenance Blocking
items.description: As a facilities staff member, I want a single view of all bookings and the ability to block a room for maintenance, so that I can manage facilities effectively.

criteria.text: When the Facilities Office views the booking system, a single view of all bookings is displayed showing who booked each room.

citations.quote: - Give the Facilities Office a single view of all bookings.
Dana (Facilities): Also, my office needs to see who booked each room.

criteria.text: When the Facilities Office blocks a room for maintenance, the room becomes unavailable for user bookings.

citations.quote: - The Facilities Office can block a room for maintenance.

questions.why_it_matters: It determines validation rules for how long a user can reserve a room.

citations.quote: - A booking can last up to 4 hours.
The brief says four hours, but three hours is the most I want for a single booking

questions.subject: Cancellation and No-Shows
questions.question: What are the rules for no-shows and how late someone can cancel a booking?
questions.why_it_matters: It defines penalties or automated freeing of rooms when users fail to attend or cancel late.

citations.quote: We have not yet agreed what happens when someone cannot attend a booking.
